newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica city tariff frozen - Spain govt.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica city tariff frozen - Spain govt.

text.p: Prices charged by Spain's domestic telephone operator Telefonica in cities will be frozen until June 1998, a spokesman for the Development Ministry confirmed on Friday.
The spokesman confirmed press reports today which quoted Development Minister Rafael Arias Salgado speaking at dinner with journalists on Thursday.
The freeze in phone charges was aimed at keeping inflation under control, and therefore not endangering Spain's chances of entering European Economic and Monetary Union, Arias Salgado said.
The spokesman also confirmed that the government will decide a date for the full liberalisation of the Spanish telecoms sector before the end of the year.
